quiz.title: Reading Practice: Community Garden
quiz.description: A short passage with three questions to try the reading feature.

passages.title: The Community Garden
paragraphs: Last year, residents turned an empty lot into a community garden. Volunteers planted vegetables and flowers, while a nearby school helped build raised beds. The garden is open every Saturday morning.
The project gives neighbors a place to meet and provides fresh vegetables for a local food bank. During dry weeks, volunteers collect rainwater from a storage tank instead of using drinking water.

questions.explanation: The first paragraph says the garden is open every Saturday morning.

questions.prompt: Which two benefits of the garden are mentioned?

options.text: Neighbors have a place to meet.
A food bank receives fresh vegetables.
The school gets a new sports field.

questions.explanation: The second paragraph mentions meeting neighbors and providing vegetables to a food bank.

questions.prompt: What do volunteers collect during dry weeks?
questions.explanation: Volunteers collect rainwater from a storage tank.
